tay: quick note — tried porting sample-app to Parcel (v2) + ESM SDK and saw an auth/retry header duplication only on edge deploys (Cloudflare Pages). Node dev server is fine.

ravi: does it fail during build or runtime?

tay: runtime. first request shows Authorization: Bearer X, then retry shows Authorization duplicated (comma-separated). Logs: 
```
[redwood] auth failed 401
Request headers: Authorization: Bearer BAD_KEY
Retrying...
Request headers: Authorization: Bearer BAD_KEY, Authorization: Bearer BAD_KEY
```

lina: hmm. Which import form and which package entry?

tay: named ESM import: `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'` in a Svelte + Parcel setup. If I change to `const c = require('@redwood/inference/dist/cjs')` it doesn't reproduce.

sam: sounds similar to other bundler regressions. Parcel may inline a Headers polyfill or hoist helpers so a Headers instance gets shared across retries. Can you share minimal repro steps?

tay: sure: 
1) git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps -b parcel-edge-esm
2) cd parcel-svelte-edge
3) npm i
4) REDWOOD_API_KEY=wrong npm run build && npm run serve:edge
5) curl -v http://localhost:8787/.netlify/functions/llm

handler (tiny): 
```js
// functions/llm.js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
export async function onRequest(context) {
  const res = await client.generate({ prompt: 'hi' });
  return new Response(await res.text());
}
```

ravi: quick mitigation: in retry code, always construct new Headers from the existing one (new Headers(oldReq.headers || {})) and pass that into new Request. That prevented duplication in my local miniflare run.

tay: did that locally too — fixed it. But there's another DX problem: TS server doesn't pick up typings when consumers import the ESM entry via Parcel. IntelliSense fails but works when importing dist/cjs. I suspect our exports map isn't pointing types at the ESM export.

sam: action items: 
- tay: push minimal repro branch + README with exact parcel config (ETA today)
- ravi: open PR to defensively clone headers in retry code and add an e2e that runs the built bundle under miniflare/cloudflare runner (ETA tomorrow)
- lina: update package.json exports to include "types" for the ESM entry and add a small tsc check CI job against a fresh Parcel+TS project (ETA EOD)

ci-bot: queued job: devex/parcel-edge-esm-repro (#501) 937

tay: oddity — switching to default import (`import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`) also stops the duplication for me. That might help pinpoint packaging vs runtime. I opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/455

sam: great, once CI reproduces across parcel/rollup/vite we'll cut a patch if needed. thanks everyone.
